merge_policy: Only events through 3 Mar T24 are visible. 4-Mar 705/706 and 331 organizational changes, I-162 Fort McCloud attack, and 8-Mar Operation INITIAL remain future.

Indian_Ocean.Eastern_Fleet: Operation SLEUTH closed with no enemy ship found. Illustrious is back at Trincomalee on 3 Mar; Gambia reached Fremantle 2 Mar; Sussex remains on separate return toward Fremantle.
Indian_Ocean.battle_squadron: Destroyer scarcity still limits heavy-ship sea time. 1-Mar exercise is cancelled after a submarine-periscope report; 2-Mar destroyers conduct a hunt southwest of Ceylon.
Indian_Ocean.Japan_surface: Historical SA No.1 is CANCELLED in current Branch state. Tone/Chikuma remain Combined-Fleet/mobile-fleet scout/screen assets on the Palau-western Philippines axis; Aoba/Kinu/Oi remain local SW Area assets. Oyodo group stays a separate contact reserve.
Indian_Ocean.Japan_air: 705 main long-range bomber flight element is moving east toward Palau/Peleliu reorganization; western long-range search depth falls to about 1-3 sorties/day by 3 Mar. 331 remains west; Tokai/MAD remains active; Ka-go local zero.
Indian_Ocean.Japan_submarines: I-37 sinks Ascot 29 Feb and reconnoiters Chagos 3 Mar; I-162/I-166 remain active. Possible Ceylon periscope identity is not promoted to confirmed I-162.

Central_Pacific.mobile_fleet: First Mobile Fleet reorganization on/around 1 Mar strengthens retention of first-line scout cruisers and carrier-screen assets; exact later fleet concentration at Lingga remains a separate basing decision.
Central_Pacific.Truk: Remains damaged air/recon/submarine staging base, not a fleet hub.
Central_Pacific.Palau_Peleliu: Begins receiving/reorganizing the transferred 705 long-range bomber element; immediate sortie generation is limited by ferry fatigue and ground-support lag.
Central_Pacific.Eniwetok: US secured; Engebi limited fighter/search staging continues. No new combat adjudication in this window.

next_exact_action: Advance 4-8 Mar. First post 4-Mar 705/706 and 331 organizational changes and I-162 Fort McCloud event; then decide whether Eastern Fleet Operation INITIAL on 8 Mar still launches under Branch threat/readiness. Separately decide whether the Japanese Mobile Fleet begins a southward fuel/training concentration toward Lingga as a fleet move, not as SA No.1.
